capacity.en: To quote him exactly, "It was a serious strategic mistake to exit nuclear energy… we simply don’t have enough energy generation capacity ."
capacity.zh: 原话是这样说的：“退出核能是一个严重的战略错误……我们根本没有足够的发电能力。”

capacity.en: Add it all together, and the nuclear capacity now committed to data centres by these companies is up to 13 gigawatts , and that is just in the United States.
capacity.zh: 总而言之，这些公司目前承诺为数据中心提供的核电容量已高达13吉瓦，而这仅仅是在美国。

cancel.en: It repealed the law completely, cancelling it as if it had never existed.
cancel.zh: 它彻底废除了这项法律，将其撤销，就像它从未存在过一样。

carbon.en: And after it's up and running , nuclear power produces almost no carbon emissions .
carbon.zh: 而且一旦投入运行，核电几乎不产生碳排放。

category.en: And regulators in the US have started treating fusion as a properly separate category from traditional nuclear power, with lighter rules, because a fusion reactor can't melt down the way a fission reactor can.
category.zh: 美国的监管机构也已开始将核聚变视为与传统核电完全不同的独立类别，适用的法规更为宽松，因为聚变反应堆不会像裂变反应堆那样发生堆芯熔毁。

cause.en: I’ve had people tell me before that they’ve been to London and they’ve not found anything nice to eat in London, which is incredible ’cause London is perhaps one of the best food cities in the entire world.
cause.zh: 以前有人对我说过，他们去过伦敦，却在伦敦找不到什么好吃的东西，这太不可思议了，因为伦敦也许是全世界最好的美食城市之一。
